summary: Feed s156_double to IDS is degraded: 9.1% duplicate packets (218/2404) and missing VLAN 20 with 50% untagged traffic reduces detection coverage and violates required VLANs [10,20].

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is aggregating overlapping SPAN/TAP sources without deduplication - same packets arriving via two paths and forwarded twice to IDS port.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS wastes CPU/memory processing duplicates, inflates flow counts, risks false positives and state-table confusion, reducing effective detection capacity despite needing full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Enable broker-level deduplication to drop identical packets within short window before delivery to IDS, restoring correct traffic volume without altering payload.

findings.root_cause: VLAN tags stripped upstream - SPAN or packet broker trunk configured to strip 802.1Q or not forwarding VLAN 20, resulting in 50% untagged packets and VLAN 20 never seen.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS is blind to all traffic on required VLAN 20, missing attacks/lateral movement in that segment and violating tool profile requirement for VLANs 10 and 20.

recommended_fix.why: Configure TAP/SPAN and packet broker to preserve 802.1Q tags and ensure trunk/broker policy forwards VLAN 20 to this IDS feed for complete coverage.
